info.description: Reads a prospect's courier invoice, compares it with the (fictional) BCOM rate card, and builds the customer proposal PDF and WhatsApp message.
info.title: BCOM Sales Assistant API

post.description:
Compares the reviewed invoice with the BCOM rate card, with an optional what-if scenario.
The summary also carries the sanity checks (totals, duplicates, outliers).

get.description: Tells the frontend which AI provider is active and what to warn about (never exposes keys).

post.description: The comparison (with any what-if) as an Excel workbook. Numbers are recalculated here.

200.description: The comparison as an Excel workbook

get.description: The app can do its work: the database answers (readiness, used by Docker healthchecks).

How often partners corrected each reader's work, the most corrected fields by courier, and the
hints the AI now gets on new reads. Built from saved proposals.

post.description: Sanity checks on the reviewed invoice (totals, duplicates, outliers). No AI, instant.

Combines 2–3 invoices from consecutive months into one, for a steadier monthly average.
Refused when periods overlap or are missing, or the currencies differ.

Reads an uploaded courier invoice and returns clean, editable data.

PDFs and photos go to the active AI provider; CSV and Excel statements are read directly, without AI.
The same file read again by the same provider and model comes from the cache (header `X-Cache: hit`).
The same read as `/extract`, reporting each stage as it happens (live progress on the upload screen).

200.description: Server-sent events: `stage` ({stage, ...}) for received, checked, reading, cleaning and checking; then `done` (the same body as /extract) or `error` ({code, message}).

post.description: Writes the WhatsApp message. Numbers are recalculated here, never taken from the browser.

get.description: Newest change first, with the count of sent proposals due for a follow-up.

post.description: Saves a draft from the reviewed invoice. The figures are calculated here.

Builds the customer proposal PDF from unsaved data (the live preview). Numbers are recalculated
here, never taken from the browser.

delete.description: Deletes the proposal, its data and its history. It can't be undone.

patch.description: Autosave and status changes. Only the fields sent are changed; figures are recalculated.

post.description: Adds a line to the history: PDF or Excel downloaded, message copied, WhatsApp opened.

get.description: The comparison as an Excel workbook, built again from the saved data.
The proposal PDF, built again from the saved data.

delete.description: Turns the customer's link off: the old address stops working. A new link can be made later.

post.description: The customer's link, made the first time (later calls return the same link).

get.description: The proposal as the customer sees it. The first opening is noted in the partner's history.

post.description: The customer accepts: the proposal becomes Won and the partner sees who accepted, with their note.
